name: advance the state by the mean of the old and new slopes
mechanism: choose the next state so that the move equals the step times the average of the rate at the current state and the rate at the next state; implicit like the backward step but second-order and non-damping

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Trapezoidal rule (differential equations)' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Crank–Nicolson method for diffusion equations':

requires: a solver for the per-step implicit equation
fails_when: oscillatory (not damped) error on very stiff components
